title: [MAIN] Subcontracting Receipt Extensibility Events.
summary: Integration events are added to subcontracting receipt posting in the India GST application, enabling partners and customers to extend and adapt the posting flow without changing core design.
key_points: Four extensibility events added to codeunits 18466 and 18467 for subcontracting receipt posting
OnBeforePostPurchOrder and OnBeforeCreatePostedReceipt events in Subcontracting Post with IsHandled support
OnRecieveBackCompOnBeforePostItemJnlLine event for raw material return journal line posting
OnBeforePostPurchOrderLine event in Subcontracting Post Batch for each subcontracting line
Posting behavior unchanged when no subscribers are present
quote: Integration events are added so that partners or customers who want different behavior can extend the flow in their own extension.
